source: Dummy native release readiness seed mirrored from feature-backlog.md, deployment.md, and manual-work-queue.md. Metadata-only; no signing keys, credentials, tokens, device IDs, or user data.
notes: Every item remains blocking until generated native projects, provider credentials, store copy, device validation, or CI ownership are approved.
This checklist tracks release-readiness scope only; it does not store signing material, APNs/FCM credentials, HealthKit/Health Connect data, backup files, or store-account identifiers.

items.label: Generated iOS/Android project folders
items.releaseRequirement: Generate and review Capacitor iOS/Android project folders after native toolchain, bundle IDs, and signing choices are ready.
decisionsRequired: Bundle IDs and app display names
Whether generated native folders are committed to the repo
Native build flavors for production, beta, and local testing
validationSteps: Run npm run native:add:ios and npm run native:add:android after toolchains are installed
Open generated projects and confirm safe-area/status-bar/splash behavior
Run npm run native:sync after production web build

items.label: Store signing and CI lane
items.releaseRequirement: Configure signing, certificates/profiles/keystores, and a macOS CI lane without committing secrets.
decisionsRequired: Apple Developer and Play Console ownership
Signing asset storage policy
Fastlane or equivalent upload workflow
Secret rotation and emergency revoke process
validationSteps: Build unsigned local native shells first
Validate signed beta build on a device
Confirm CI secrets are masked and never printed

items.label: Native push credentials and devices
items.releaseRequirement: Validate APNs/FCM delivery on real devices while keeping reminder payloads generic and measurement-free.
decisionsRequired: APNs key/certificate ownership
FCM project ownership
Unsubscribe and token cleanup policy
Production delivery schedule
validationSteps: Register token on iOS and Android devices
Send dry-run and live stale-trend reminders
Confirm backend stores token hashes and timestamp-only schedules

items.label: HealthKit / Health Connect validation
items.releaseRequirement: Install native health plugins, approve permission copy, and validate local write/read flows on devices.
decisionsRequired: HealthKit and Health Connect permission wording
Whether reads/imports are in launch scope
Which health categories remain write-preview only
Support plan for denied or revoked permissions
validationSteps: Install native health plugins in generated project folders
Write a test weight/workout/nutrition batch on each platform
Verify no food names, notes, account IDs, or raw private labels leave local storage

items.label: Native encrypted backup cloud policy
items.releaseRequirement: Decide whether iCloud/Google Drive backup hooks ship and keep backup blobs client-side encrypted.
decisionsRequired: iCloud and Google Drive storage policy
Whether backup files are app-scoped or user-selected exports
Recovery wording for lost passphrases
Whether future sync must remain client-side encrypted
validationSteps: Validate native file save/restore/delete on generated projects
Confirm cloud backup cannot read plaintext without the user passphrase
Review platform backup exclusions for photo bytes and app data

items.label: Native home-screen widget extensions
items.releaseRequirement: Build iOS/Android widget extensions around the measurement-free widget snapshot.
decisionsRequired: Widget extension design for iOS and Android
Shared storage/app group policy
Refresh cadence and stale-state behavior
validationSteps: Read widget payload from native shared storage
Confirm widget never displays raw measurements
Validate refresh after account check-in save

items.label: Live update signing and rollout
items.releaseRequirement: Approve live-update provider or self-hosted path, signed bundle workflow, staged rollout, and rollback policy.
decisionsRequired: Capgo/self-hosted provider decision
Bundle signing key storage
Staged rollout and rollback policy
Store-policy review for live updates
validationSteps: Generate signed beta bundle artifact
Validate update status on web/native shells
Exercise rollback path without leaking account data

items.label: Store content rating and corpus scope
items.releaseRequirement: Decide 17+ rating, native corpus trimming, store disclosures, and fallback UX for web-only corpus entries.
decisionsRequired: iOS full-depth versus trimmed corpus decision
Google Play equivalent content-rating responses
Store listing medical/health disclaimer wording
Fallback UX for excluded high-risk entries
validationSteps: Review native store questionnaires against final corpus scope
Confirm high-risk entries are excluded or gated as approved
Verify store listing screenshots do not imply medical guidance
